metrics.method: Full history 2025-09-14 to 2026-08-26, 1,461 non-service messages. Client side = the client_aliases in config/clients.yaml (Alex Paige, Ethan Ok, 850 msgs); everyone else treated as our side (611 msgs across 16 senders). client_questions_total = client messages containing '?' or opening with an interrogative. unanswered_over_24h = those with no non-templated reply from our side within 24h (templated = DMCA/leak-removal reports, reel-inspo link dumps, invoice and banking broadcasts, resource drops); at least 3 of the 6 were never answered at all. max_team_silence_days = longest gap between consecutive messages from our side (8.7d, 2026-08-01 to 2026-08-10); excluding templated cadence the longest gap with no substantive outbound is 11.5d (2026-08-14 to 2026-08-25). Promises = explicit forward commitments made by our side, hand-counted across the full log; 'kept' requires visible delivery in-chat, 'lapsed' means no delivery and no further mention.
